title: UX Design Intern – Summer 2027
note: E-commerce software UX internship for juniors or seniors in design, product design or UX with 1-2 UX case studies.

facts.summary: Full-time summer UX internship at an e-commerce marketplace company.
facts.duties: User research, wireframes with existing interface patterns, workflow interaction design, documenting requirements, user testing, presenting concepts.
facts.requirements: Junior or senior standing in design, product design, UX or related; portfolio with 1-2 UX projects; Figma; video editing and user testing tools.
